title: Motorbike Flood Stall Hazard Level Classifier (cm Depth)

blocker.detail: The only 6-class segmentation IR has an untrained head and the deployed cv-engine runs a Detect model, so water masks, measured depths and hazard levels cannot be produced from live frames.
evidence: live probe of 8 real frames -> max hazard level null, max water_ratio 0

automated_gates.summary: web unit suite 303 pass / 0 fail, Go suite all packages ok, cv-engine hazard classifier 71 tests ok
automated_gates.detail:
- Web: `npm test` → 303 pass, 0 fail.
- Go: `go test ./...` → all packages ok.
- cv-engine: `python3 -m unittest test_hazard_classifier.py` → 71 tests ok (executed live during this verification).

findings.detail: A null level with no depth rendering the legacy badge conforms to AC14/spec §6.2; the scenario is blocked only because no live frame can supply an avoidance level pending S12-T5 (#411).
CameraModal now features an in-modal EN/VI toggle button in its header, verified dynamically in Chrome CDP.

The four endpoints marshal the same hotset.Verdict, but the pointer fields are omitted while every verdict carries a null level; parity across endpoints can only be asserted once a verdict carries one.
GET /api/v1/cameras/hotset/status returned 0 verdicts during the run while snapshots kept archiving; the client rejects verdicts older than 24 h, leaving only pre-migration rows renderable.
